description: This PHP file defines the EmployeePersonalDetailController class within the OrangeHRM application. It handles the setup of the employee personal details view, including determining user permissions, fetching nationalities, and configuring Vue components with relevant props based on the request.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailController
classes.description: A controller class managing the employee personal details view, including permission checks and component configuration.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the NationalityService instance used to fetch nationality data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee-specific data and permissions based on the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data groups for capability permission checking, specifically related to personal information.
